# AWS Resource Access Manager

Store resource shares and resource/principal associations as configuration records without real cross-account access or invitations.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ram` |
| Signing name | `ram` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-01-04` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 9 of 35 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-resource-access-manager) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Configuration records only; no invitations, real cross-account access, or authorization enforcement.
- Managed permissions and permission associations are excluded (AssociateResourceSharePermission, etc.).
- Customer managed permissions and policy creation are excluded.
- AWS Organizations integration and EnableSharingWithAwsOrganization are excluded.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
